title: Count before or after the join?
prompt: What does this program print? Both versions count trips per pickup zone name. The 12 lesson trips start in 6 different zones, all of them in `taxi_zones`. `profile` is the lesson's helper; for each version the loop prints how many shuffles ran, the rows each one shuffled, and the rows the join produced. Type each printed line on its own line.
hints: The first line checks the rows before any profile: do the two versions give the same counts per zone?
`join_first` joins every trip to its zone and then counts; `count_first` counts first, so its join sees one row per zone.
Each grouping adds up within the partition before its shuffle, and `trips` is one partition. The broadcast join adds no `Exchange`.
